name: Dolya and Sudba
description: Personifications of personal fate and fortune. Dolya brings luck; Nedolya brings misfortune. Together they weave the thread of each human life.
mythology: Dolya (Good Fate) and Nedolya (Bad Fate/Misfortune) are personified fate-spirits assigned to each person at birth. Dolya is a beautiful young woman who follows the lucky person, while Nedolya is a haggard old woman who plagues the unlucky. Sudba (Destiny) is the broader force governing one's fixed life path. In Serbian tradition, Sreća (Luck) is a woman who spins fate. You cannot fully escape your Sudba, but keeping your Dolya happy through righteous living helps. These spirits reflect the deep Slavic philosophical sense that fate is a personal, woven thing — a thread spun at one's birth.
